x: John Burr, once more in action after a leg injury, finished 3rd in the three miles in one of his best times which augurs well for a good winter season and in this race we also had Alan Bishop, Edmunds and Tom Carter, this having become a weekly effort for Tom - just like old times.

It was now becoming obvious that the team had "had it" but one bright feature was the running of I. Edmunds. He had been back in the seventies early on but each time we saw him he was further up and was now 48th.
